texts.zh: 你好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们了解到，你们的帝国在一个濒危种群的星球找到了一份数据存储。该存储包含了这个种群的大脑扫描结果。虽说你们还过于原始，无法将这数据化为实用，但我们还是要赞美你们为保存这曾经辉煌的文明最后的遗物而做出的努力。为了在我们的濒危种群保护区中留存此种群并加以记录，我们希望你们能将这份数据交给我们，并使用我们的克隆技术复活几个该种群的生物。能不能将这数据与我们分享，方便我们合力完成这种群的遗愿呢？
texts.en: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We understand that your empire has come into possession of a cache of data containing the brain scans of an extinct species, taken from the very world they once inhabited. Even though your species is still too primitive to utilize this data, we laud your efforts in preserving this last remnant of a once vibrant civilization. As part of our efforts to conserve and catalog endangered species in our Endangered Species Preserve, we wish to take this data and use our cloning technologies to bring a small number of this species back to life. Will you share it with us so we can fulfill their last wish together?

label.zh: 我们会给你拷贝一份的。
label.en: We'll make a copy for you.

tooltips.zh: 来自早已死亡的种群——[FallenEmpireDeadSpecies.GetSpeciesName]的100£pop£人口会出现在[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetAdjective]的濒危种群保护区中。
tooltips.en: 100 £pop£ Pops of the long-dead [FallenEmpireDeadSpecies.GetSpeciesName] species will be created in the [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetAdjective] Endangered Species Preserve.

tooltips.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]会很满意的，也许还会在未来对我们加以青睐。
tooltips.en: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] will be pleased, and may show us favor in the future.

label.zh: 我们还是自己留着比较好。
label.en: I think we'll hold onto it.
